title: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
author: C. S. Lewis
summary: Four siblings sent away from wartime London find a wardrobe that leads into a snowy land where it is always winter and never Christmas. A talking lion and an ancient prophecy put them at the centre of a struggle against a witch.
readIf: you want a short, classic children's adventure with talking animals and a clear good-versus-evil story.
skipIf: you want complex characters or find overt allegory and old-fashioned narration irritating.

pairings.reason: A darker, more questioning children's fantasy that is often seen as a reply to this kind of story.
Another portal-style classic where a child is swept into a magical land and has to find her way home.
Another cozy, adventurous classic with a gentle narrator and a clear sense of wonder.
